notes.title: 2024.1.11 version update
notes.content:
1. The power multiplier for Abyss automatic skipping has been changed to 1.1 times
2. Fix the issue of incorrect skill scroll giveaways
3. Fix the error in the "ordering" status of the lemon water dew combination

notes.title: 2024.1.9 Updated content
notes.content:
2024/1/9

Version update content

1<Iridescent goblins>. The <list>system opening level has been downgraded

<Iridescent goblins>Open Level: Lv.7→ Lv.6
<list>Open Level: Lv.6→ Lv.7

2. The difficulty of the lemonade trio has been reduced

The difficulty of the trio in the Gate chapter is too high, so the difficulty of the trio is lowered.

3. The price of items in the NPC store in the chapter has been reduced

When you encounter the NPC Store during the game, you don't have enough currency to purchase, so you can't reach 100% of the player's chapter progress.
This time, we have lowered the selling prices of all NPC shops and items in the map.

4. Boss: Hermit BUG fix

Encountering a boss (hermit) cannot end the round while fighting it, this bug has been fixed.
